post_topic: Fail-closed vs. fail-open: compliance as an engineering decision
image_description:
Single standalone diagram. One concept only. No panels, no grids, no collages. Full bleed 1080x1080px white background.

Title at top center in bold navy text: "Fail-Open vs. Fail-Closed: Compliance Is an Engineering Decision"

The diagram is a single vertical flow split into two parallel columns, left and right, each tracing the same starting condition through divergent paths. Both columns share the same top node.

Top center: one rounded rectangle labeled "Email Send Triggered" with a small envelope icon. A single arrow descends from this node and splits into two downward arrows — one going left, one going right.

LEFT COLUMN (header label in amber #F5A623 at column top): "Fail-Open"
Left arrow leads to a diamond decision node: "Mailing Address Config Missing?"
From the Yes branch: a rounded rectangle in blue #5a96ff labeled "Substitute Placeholder / Skip Footer" with a checkmark icon.
Arrow continues down to a rounded rectangle labeled "Email Sends" with a green send icon.
Arrow continues down to a final rounded rectangle in red-orange with bold amber border labeled "CAN-SPAM Violation" with a warning triangle icon. Small subtext inside: "40,000 sends. Legal exposure. Deferred liability."

RIGHT COLUMN (header label in amber #F5A623 at column top): "Fail-Closed"
Right arrow leads to the same diamond decision shape: "Mailing Address Config Missing?"
From the Yes branch: a rounded rectangle in navy #0A0F1E with white text labeled "Raise Exception / Halt Process" with a stop-sign icon.
Arrow continues down to a rounded rectangle in blue #5a96ff labeled "Gap Made Visible" with a spotlight/magnifying glass icon. Small subtext: "Alert fires. Config fixed. No sends."
Arrow continues down to a final rounded rectangle with a green border labeled "Compliance Preserved" with a shield icon.

A horizontal divider line separates the two columns visually. Center of diagram between the two columns has a small vertical label in gray italics: "same trigger, different design decision"

At the very bottom of the diagram, a single callout box spanning full width in amber #F5A623 background with navy text: "If the missing value produces an illegal artifact — raise. Don't default. Don't warn and continue. Stop."

Navy #0A0F1E primary elements, blue #5a96ff highlights, amber #F5A623 callouts and important labels. Clean sans-serif font. Real cloud provider logos where relevant. Small text "Kelvin Davis" bottom right corner. Professional LinkedIn infographic style similar to ByteByteGo. White background. No dark backgrounds.
